about_the_game:
About This Game

Survive, explore, and uncover the truth behind a land consumed by false faith.

MysteryJar is a fast-paced roguelike survival game designed to be played in rounds of 10 minutes. Every session challenges you to explore different maps, gather resources, and build a stronghold with your allies. Work together to defend against relentless waves of monstrous creatures determined to wipe you out.

The story begins with an order from the Destroyer—an ancient power seeking to expand its dominion by releasing evil into the world of mankind. In the land of Gullmörk, a false religion called Blekkingar arises, disguised as faith but spreading corruption that slowly consumes its followers. As the true believers of the Creator dwindle, unnatural beasts multiply beyond the safe zones, severing paths and isolating villages.

When Father Lucas witnesses the growing threat, he warns the elder of Furu Village. Together, they rally survivors to venture beyond the barricades, search for the cause of the corruption, and reclaim safety for the land once more.

Features

  • Roguelike Survival Gameplay – Face unique challenges every 10-minute run.

  • Explore & Build – Scavenge the map, fortify your base, and prepare for waves of attacks.

  • Co-op Focused – Team up with others to endure together against growing dangers.

  • Relentless Monsters – Fight off creatures that evolve and grow stronger with each round.

  • Friendly Art Style – Bright colors, flat shading, and simple 3D models create a fun, approachable atmosphere for all players.

Will you survive the curse of Gullmörk, or be consumed by the lies of Blekkingar?

Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 (64-bit) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7850 / Intel Iris HD 620
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 MB available space
